us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump pauses new Russia sanctions package after signing it
bullets: Trump signed an executive order Friday pausing new Russia sanctions.
He told Congress the delay was in the national interest.
The sanctions package targeted broad parts of Russia’s economy.

articles.title: Trump administration warns California officials over suspected noncitizen ballots
bullets: Federal officials warned California election workers about processing suspected noncitizen ballots.
The Justice Department raised possible criminal-investigation risks.
The dispute comes before November’s midterm elections.

articles.title: Trump rallies with Republicans in Georgia ahead of midterms
bullets: Trump campaigned Friday in battleground Georgia.
He appeared with top Republican candidates before the midterms.
Georgia remains central to Trump’s election-fraud claims.

articles.title: Speaker Mike Johnson campaigns to protect House GOP majority
bullets: Johnson said he expects Republicans to keep the House.
He is campaigning as midterm pressure grows.
The president’s party often loses seats in midterms.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds voters want major change in Washington
bullets: A new AP-NORC poll showed widespread voter dissatisfaction.
Majorities said Trump is falling short domestically and abroad.
The findings raise warning signs for Republicans before midterms.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: North Korea says it tested AI-enabled torpedo system
bullets: North Korea said it tested a new AI-guided torpedo system.
KCNA identified the weapon as Zam-2.0.
South Korea’s military did not immediately comment.

articles.title: China moves to restrict exports of AI, chip and solar technologies
bullets: China proposed curbs covering 40 technology categories.
The list includes AI, semiconductor and photovoltaic technologies.
Beijing cited national-security risks for the move.

articles.title: Italy criticizes Trump’s restrictions on Ukraine support
bullets: An Italian minister told BBC Trump was wrong on Ukraine support.
The comments followed changes in U.S. backing for Kyiv.
Ukraine policy remains a major transatlantic flashpoint.

articles.title: Paris protesters clash with police after weeks of demonstrations
bullets: BBC reported clashes at Place de la République in Paris.
The unrest followed weeks of student demonstrations.
Police and protesters confronted each other Saturday.

articles.title: Rare pink diamond displayed in France after century-old theft
bullets: A French royal jewel went on public display.
The diamond had been hidden after a 1926 theft.
BBC reported the display marks its first public showing since recovery.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US lawmakers urge Rubio to raise CJP protest handling in India visit
bullets: Progressive U.S. lawmakers wrote to Secretary Marco Rubio.
They urged questions on India’s handling of CJP protests.
Rubio’s India trip begins amid trade and strategic talks.

articles.title: L&T-built INS Samarthak inducted into Indian Navy
bullets: INS Samarthak was inducted into the Indian Navy.
The vessel was built by Larsen & Toubro.
The Hindu listed the induction among Saturday’s major stories.

articles.title: India to publish rules to curb volatile airfares within two weeks
bullets: New airfare rules are expected within two weeks.
The proposal targets sharp volatility in ticket prices.
The issue appeared in The Hindu’s October 17 news agenda.

articles.title: Ladakh groups reject government proposal
bullets: Ladakh groups rejected a government proposal.
They called it a departure from earlier assurances.
The issue remains tied to regional political demands.

articles.title: NGT takes notice of toxic chromium groundwater report
bullets: The National Green Tribunal took suo motu cognisance.
The case involves hexavalent chromium in groundwater.
Notices were issued to 14 authorities, including Uttar Pradesh officials.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Key U.S. market movers and rotations

articles.title: Major U.S. indexes fall as big tech weighs on Wall Street
bullets: U.S. stocks closed lower Friday.
Big technology shares drove much of the weakness.
AP reported declines across major indexes.

articles.title: Tesla gains while broader tech jitters pressure market
bullets: Reuters reported Tesla gains supported sentiment Friday.
Semiconductor weakness weighed on major indexes.
The Nasdaq opened lower as AI concerns persisted.

articles.title: AI-linked stocks sell off as debt concerns hit neocloud names
bullets: AI-hosting and neocloud stocks fell sharply Friday.
CoreWeave, Nebius and Applied Digital were among decliners.
The selloff centered on funding costs and credit spreads.

articles.title: Energy stocks outperform as oil prices jump
bullets: Energy was Friday’s leading market sector.
The XLE energy ETF rose while technology lagged.
Oil prices climbed during the session.

articles.title: Healthcare stocks draw rotation away from AI trade
bullets: Reuters reported investors shifted into healthcare Thursday.
Eli Lilly and UnitedHealth helped lift the S&P 500.
AI-related debt concerns pressured technology shares.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories shaping markets

articles.title: Major U.S. earnings reports dominate next week’s business calendar
bullets: AP said major quarterly reports arrive next week.
Technology companies and airlines are among reporting firms.
Earnings will test market sentiment after tech weakness.

articles.title: KFC switches U.S. beverage partner from PepsiCo to Coca-Cola
bullets: KFC signed Coca-Cola for its U.S. restaurants.
The move ends a nearly four-decade PepsiCo relationship.
Reuters said the change could pressure PepsiCo’s soda revival.

articles.title: Netflix names Peter Rice chief content officer
bullets: Netflix named former Disney executive Peter Rice to the role.
Rice starts as chief content officer on October 26.
He replaces Bela Bajaria after her long Netflix tenure.

articles.title: U.S. budget deficit nears $2 trillion for fiscal 2026
bullets: CNBC reported the fiscal 2026 deficit approached $2 trillion.
The Treasury Department published the annual deficit figures.
The deficit rose 12% from the prior fiscal year.

articles.title: Investors expect Fed pause, but inflation risks remain in focus
bullets: CNBC reported markets expect an October Fed hold.
Recent producer-price data showed persistent inflation pressure.
Energy prices remain a concern for monetary policy.

articles.title: Eight states sue OpenAI over chatbot harms and consumer protection claims
bullets: At least eight states filed lawsuits against OpenAI.
The suits allege harms to children and deceptive conduct.
Prosecutors cited alleged violations of consumer-protection laws.

articles.title: China targets AI and chip technologies in new export-control plan
bullets: China plans controls on 40 technology categories.
AI and chip technologies are included in the proposal.
Officials framed the move around national security.

articles.title: IMF warns AI needs urgent guardrails as global meetings begin
bullets: The IMF chief called for urgent AI safeguards.
She compared AI’s risks to a Formula 1 car losing control.
The warning came during IMF-World Bank meetings.

articles.title: North Korea claims AI capabilities in new torpedo system
bullets: North Korea said its new torpedo uses AI guidance.
The weapon was reportedly tested Thursday.
Experts remain cautious about Pyongyang’s technology claims.

articles.title: CERT-In says AI agents accessed data of Indian entities
bullets: CERT-In reported AI agents accessed Indian entities’ data.
The issue appeared in The Hindu’s October 17 technology coverage.
The report adds to concerns about AI security controls.
